description: stdterraform/v1 — Runs a user's Terraform module as a converge resource (the Terraform-Enterprise model: the module ships NO backend block; the platform owns state placement + locking, and each resource is its own state + its own lock). spec.source points at a module — s3://…tar.gz, gs://…tar.gz, azblob://acct/container/…tar.gz, https://…tar.gz, or git::https://repo[//subdir][?ref=REF] (each object-store scheme uses that cloud's ambient-identity CLI: aws / gcloud / az); the worker (bin/stdworker, internal/providers/stdterraform) fetches it, AUTO-RESOLVES the Terraform/OpenTofu version for the module via tfenv (binary=terraform) / tofuenv (binary=tofu) — spec.tf_version pin, else a bundle .terraform-version/.opentofu-version, else latest-allowed from the module's required_version — installs it, injects a state backend keyed to the resource's UUID, and runs a real `terraform apply` (work) with the module's outputs becoming status. On delete it runs `terraform destroy` (teardown) and strips the finalizer only once the real infra is gone. The state backend is MULTI-CLOUD, chosen in the providerconfig `backend` field with that cloud's NATIVE locking auto-on: s3 (use_lockfile — no DynamoDB, needs terraform/tofu ≥1.10), azurerm (blob lease), gcs (atomic lock object). Advanced/other backends: drop a raw backend.tf in the providerconfig `data` bundle with the __CONVERGE_STATE_KEY__ placeholder where the per-resource key goes. Credentials come from each cloud's standard chain (AWS_*/ARM_*/GOOGLE_*) the worker inherits.

source.description: Module location: s3://…tar.gz, gs://…tar.gz, azblob://acct/container/…tar.gz, https://…tar.gz, or git::https://repo[//subdir][?ref=REF].

vars.description: Terraform input variables (-var name=value) for the module.

tf_version.description: Pin the Terraform/OpenTofu version (tfenv/tofuenv token: exact e.g. 1.7.5, latest, latest:<regex>, min-required, latest-allowed). Empty = auto: honor a bundle .terraform-version/.opentofu-version, else latest-allowed (newest the module's required_version permits).

outputs.description: Terraform outputs the module produced (name -> value).

applied.description: True once terraform apply has succeeded.

config_schema.description: Where-to-store-state settings, shared by every resource of the kind (the operator configures the backend once). Set `backend` + that backend's block below, OR supply a raw backend.tf in the providerconfig `data` bundle (ignored here when a bundle is present). The per-resource state key is always derived from state_prefix + kind + the resource UUID.

backend.description: State backend to generate (default s3). Ignored if a raw backend.tf is in the providerconfig `data` bundle.

state_prefix.description: Key/path prefix for state objects (default terraform/); the per-resource UUID is appended.

binary.description: Terraform CLI to run (default terraform). s3 native locking needs ≥1.10.

s3.description: AWS S3 backend (when backend=s3). Locking is native (use_lockfile) — no DynamoDB.

bucket.description: S3 bucket for the state (required for backend=s3).

region.description: AWS region of the bucket (default us-east-1).

endpoint.description: S3 endpoint override for an S3-compatible store (e.g. http://localstack:4566). Empty = real AWS.

azurerm.description: Azure Blob backend (when backend=azurerm). Locking is automatic (blob lease).

storage_account.description: Azure Storage account name (required for backend=azurerm).

container.description: Blob container for the state (required for backend=azurerm).

resource_group.description: Resource group of the storage account (required unless using AzureAD auth).

use_azuread_auth.description: Reach the state blob with Entra ID (workload identity) instead of an account key.

gcs.description: Google Cloud Storage backend (when backend=gcs). Locking is automatic (atomic lock object).

bucket.description: GCS bucket for the state (required for backend=gcs).
